about_the_game:
For those who want their legend written in gold.

Show your support for Achilles: Survivor and help us shape its future - while giving every hero the Midas touch. The Supporter Pack is for players who want to back ongoing development of our games and get a small cosmetic bonus in return. Inspired by the legend of King Midas, it adds a gold skin for every playable character and a supporter badge on the main menu.

Here’s what you get:

  • Gold skins for all characters - a Midas-touched variant for every Survivor.

  • Quick on/off toggle in the character selection screen so you can swap between gold and your usual look anytime.

  • Exclusive supporter badge in the main menu - a clear mark of your backing and a badge of honor for Myrmidons who stand with us.

Important note: This DLC has no gameplay impact. By getting it, you’re directly supporting the ongoing development of Achilles: Survivor and our future games. The gold skins and badge are just our way of saying “thank you!”

So thank you for standing with us and helping keep Achilles’ story alive ❤️

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Intel® Core™ i3-8100
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 4GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 560 4GB
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 2600X / Intel® Core™ i5-8400
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 6GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580

short_description: Some gold does glitter - like your support for our games. Inspired by the legend of King Midas, this purely cosmetic DLC gilds every character in radiant gold and grants an exclusive menu badge. Shine brighter in battle and stand with us as we forge the future of Achilles: Survivor.
